entities.name: NAS message container
entities.description: An information element that contains NAS messages, included when specific conditions are met for secure transmission of non-cleartext IEs.

entities.name: REGISTRATION REQUEST
entities.description: A NAS message used by the UE to initiate registration with the network.

entities.name: UE sending REGISTRATION REQUEST as initial NAS message
entities.description: Condition where the UE sends a REGISTRATION REQUEST message as the first NAS message in a communication session.

entities.name: UE has valid 5G NAS security context
entities.description: Condition indicating the UE possesses an active and valid 5G NAS security context for secure communications.

entities.name: UE needs to send non-cleartext IEs
entities.description: Condition where the UE requires transmission of information elements that must not be sent in cleartext, necessitating protection.

relations.description: The REGISTRATION REQUEST message may contain the NAS message container IE under specific conditions.
Inclusion of the NAS message container IE is guarded by the condition that the REGISTRATION REQUEST is sent as an initial NAS message.
Inclusion of the NAS message container IE is guarded by the condition that the UE has a valid 5G NAS security context.
Inclusion of the NAS message container IE is guarded by the condition that the UE needs to send non-cleartext IEs.
